title: India's Semiconductor Supplier Ecosystem: The Dholera Play
subtitle: Mapping the supplier stack, anchor investments and build-ready parts for Dholera as a fab-led industrial node.
summary: A ground-up supplier ecosystem assessment for Dholera, covering wafer fab equipment, materials, chemicals, packaging, testing and the industrial policy levers needed to move from announcement to output.

source.cover: D:/techadyant/labs_techadyant/Reports and DPR/In-progress/06_Industrial & Deep Tech/Techadyant_Dholera_Supplier_Ecosystem_Report/Dholera Semiconductor ecosystem.jpg

signal.excerpt: Dholera's supplier ecosystem is now mapped at component level. This report identifies the build-ready anchor investments, gaps and policy levers for a fab-led node.
takeaways: Wafer fab equipment and chemicals remain the highest-value localisation gaps in Gujarat's semiconductor push.
Dholera's supplier readiness varies sharply across packaging/testing versus front-end fab materials.
Industrial policy, power and water infrastructure are now the binding constraints, not capital alone.
